generated_from: Claude Code session transcripts via Hamilton profile.py (jobs/hamilton-token-audit); per-call usage_records, sanitized by jobs/bentham/sessions.py
token_categories_note: fresh_input, cache_read, cache_write and output are separate, nonoverlapping categories and are never summed together. Null means no value observed.

prices.basis: list price per call: exact model, cache-write class, fast mode (usage.speed) and Haiku 5.5 long-prompt rates; API-equivalent estimate, not an invoice

notes: Agents counted per grouping can overlap across groupings when one agent used several models.
Main (coordinator) transcripts are partial: they can span work earlier than the labelled phase.
Output tokens may be a lower bound where a call never recorded a final count.
Tokens are what transcripts recorded; they are not an invoice.
